Play or Event for Kids and Teens | Komitas Chamber Music House
Organ Tales: A Journey into the Magical World of the Organ
2026-09-15
Price 3000, 4000, 5000 AMD
On September 15, at 7:00 PM, the Komitas Chamber Music Hall will host a concert-performance entitled "Organ Tales: A Journey into the Magical World of the Organ".

The audience will discover the magical world of organ tales in a new spirit and mood. 

In the format of a fairy tale and interesting scenario solutions, beloved actress Hasmik Verdyan will introduce children to the magical world of the organ through games and jokes, turning an ordinary evening into a real musical fairy tale.

And talented organists Lusine Harutyunyan and Anna Bakunts will transport children to the world of organ sounds with live performances, through beautiful melodies from Bach to Harry Potter. Organist Harutyun Tagvoryan will play the role of the dwarf.

Children will not only listen to music, but also become a part of the story, participating in games and discovering how the organ can speak the language of music.

Dear parents, do not miss this musical meeting. This is a unique opportunity to combine art and play, education and entertainment.

Time: 19:00.
The concert-performance is intended for children aged 4 and older.
